moments.title: Premier League Sunday Showdown
moments.blurb: Today features a packed schedule of Premier League action across the UK, with key matches including Liverpool vs Brighton and Manchester United vs Bournemouth.

angles.name: Match Day Kick-Off
angles.copy: Sunday means Premier League football! Who are you backing today? Liverpool face Brighton, while Man Utd take on Bournemouth. Big points at stake. #PremierLeague

angles.name: Liverpool vs Brighton Focus
angles.copy: Title race implications at Anfield? Liverpool host Brighton today. Expect fireworks. Who needs the win more?

angles.name: Man Utd vs Bournemouth Focus
angles.copy: Old Trafford is calling! Manchester United welcome Bournemouth this afternoon. Can the Red Devils get a crucial home win?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Week 5 Results
moments.blurb: The tension builds tonight as another couple faces elimination in the Strictly Come Dancing Week 5 results show on BBC One, featuring a performance by Melanie C.

angles.name: Results Show Tonight
angles.copy: It's results night on Strictly! Who's safe, and who's dancing for their survival? Tune into BBC One tonight at 7:10 PM for the Week 5 results.

angles.name: Melanie C Performance
angles.copy: Spice up your Sunday! Melanie C joins the pros for a special performance on tonight's Strictly results show. Get ready for some high-energy moves.

moments.title: New UK TV Dramas Launch Today
moments.blurb: Two anticipated new dramas, 'Adultery' on ITV and the second season of 'This City is Ours' on BBC One, both premiere tonight.

angles.name: Sunday Night Drama
angles.copy: Your Sunday night TV just got busier! New drama 'Adultery' starts on ITV, and 'This City is Ours' returns for Season 2 on BBC One. What's first on your watchlist?

angles.name: Adultery Premiere
angles.copy: Messy relationships and secrets unfold in 'Adultery', the new drama kicking off tonight on ITV. Get ready for a rollercoaster ride.

moments.title: Jamie Miller Tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Cardiff-born artist Jamie Miller has scored a UK Official Singles Chart Number 1 with 'Babydoll', becoming the first Welsh solo male artist to do so in 41 years.

angles.name: Welsh Chart Topper
angles.copy: Huge congratulations to Cardiff's own Jamie Miller! His track 'Babydoll' is officially the UK Number 1 single. A massive achievement for Welsh music!

angles.name: History Made
angles.copy: Jamie Miller just made history! The first Welsh solo male artist to top the UK Singles Chart in 41 years. What an incredible milestone!

moments.title: Halloween is Next Saturday
moments.blurb: Halloween falls on Saturday, October 31st, 2026, making it a prime weekend for spooky celebrations and trick-or-treating across the UK.

angles.name: Weekend Halloween
angles.copy: Get your costumes ready! Halloween is next Saturday, October 31st. A weekend Halloween means more time for spooky fun and trick-or-treating!

angles.name: Planning Your Spooks
angles.copy: Just six days until Halloween! Planning a party, trick-or-treating, or a scary movie marathon? Tell us your spooky plans for next Saturday.

moments.title: Bonfire Night Next Thursday
moments.blurb: Bonfire Night, or Guy Fawkes Night, is on Thursday, November 5th, with many firework displays and events scheduled across the UK for the following weekend.

angles.name: Remember Remember
angles.copy: Remember, remember the 5th of November! Bonfire Night is just around the corner. Are you looking forward to fireworks and bonfires next week?

angles.name: Weekend Displays
angles.copy: While Bonfire Night is next Thursday, many spectacular firework displays will be happening across the UK on the weekend of November 7th and 8th. Time to plan ahead!

moments.title: Steve Hackett at Royal Albert Hall
moments.blurb: Former Genesis guitarist Steve Hackett performs at the Royal Albert Hall in London on Monday, October 26th.

angles.name: Prog Rock Legend
angles.copy: Prog rock royalty in London tomorrow! Steve Hackett, the legendary guitarist from Genesis, takes the stage at the Royal Albert Hall. Don't miss it!

moments.title: James Blake UK Dates
moments.blurb: James Blake continues his 'Trying Times Tour' in the UK with dates in Manchester (October 25-26) and Bristol (October 28-29).

angles.name: Live Electronic
angles.copy: James Blake is in Manchester tonight and tomorrow, then Bristol later this week! Catch the 'Trying Times Tour' for an immersive electronic experience.

moments.title: Johnny Marr's 63rd Birthday
moments.blurb: Johnny Marr, iconic guitarist and songwriter from The Smiths, turns 63 on Halloween, October 31st.

angles.name: Marr's Milestone
angles.copy: Happy almost birthday to the legendary Johnny Marr! The Smiths' guitarist turns 63 this Halloween. What's your favourite Marr riff?

moments.title: Larry Mullen Jr.'s 65th Birthday
moments.blurb: U2 drummer Larry Mullen Jr. celebrates his 65th birthday on Halloween, October 31st.

angles.name: U2 Drummer's Day
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 65th birthday to U2's incredible drummer, Larry Mullen Jr., this Halloween! What's your favourite U2 track?

moments.title: Randy Jackson's 65th Birthday
moments.blurb: Randy Jackson, the youngest of the Jackson brothers and a member of The Jackson 5, turns 65 on October 29th.

angles.name: Jackson Family Birthday
angles.copy: A big birthday for Randy Jackson this Thursday! The Jackson 5 member celebrates his 65th. What's your favourite Jackson's hit?

moments.title: Duran Duran at The O2
moments.blurb: New Wave legends Duran Duran are set to play a major show at The O2 in London on Halloween, Saturday, October 31st.

angles.name: Halloween with Duran Duran
angles.copy: Fancy a wild Halloween night? Duran Duran are playing The O2 in London next Saturday! Get ready to dance into the night.

moments.title: Celebrity Race Across the World Returns
moments.blurb: The fourth celebrity season of 'Race Across the World' is set to premiere on BBC One on Wednesday, October 28th.

angles.name: Adventure TV
angles.copy: Get ready for more globetrotting drama! Celebrity 'Race Across the World' is back for its fourth season this Wednesday on BBC One. Where will they go next?

moments.title: The Script UK Tour Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Script embark on their UK and Ireland tour starting October 30th, supporting their new album 'The User's Guide to Being Human', with dates including Cardiff and London.

angles.name: The Script Live
angles.copy: The Script are hitting the road! Their UK tour kicks off this Friday, with dates across the country including Cardiff and London. Who's got tickets?
